QUOTE: Each notice names the action that clears it, because the three axes need different actions.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the axes need different actions and tabulates them (data → rebuild via refresh; code → restart the MCP client; schema → no rebuild clears it), and it explains that a rebuild through a code-stale process is wrong. That covers the rebuild-versus-restart distinction. It never says outright that this is why one flag would not have been enough, but the per-axis reasoning carries the substance.
